children: ZECUSD near $1,424 after Paradigm co-founder Matt Huang confirmed Paradigm holds ZEC and invests in Zcash Open Development Lab. ZEC rose ~10% intraday; +185% 30d, +2,600% 1y (CoinGecko).
Zcash (ZECUSD) governance votes: 99.9% approved cutting block time to 25s from 75s; 97% approved delaying the network sustainability fee until Feb 2031. Votes coincided with ZECUSD price move.
Zcash/USD (ZECUSD) technical note: momentum aiming for $1,800 year-end. Near-term resistance ~ $1,500; support around $1,350—key levels for traders monitoring upside or pullback.
ZECUSD jumped ~17% in 24h to about $1,370, hitting a multi-year high above $1,300; a $1M short was liquidated as price moved against the position.
Fortitude Mining mined 72,696 ZEC in H1 2026 (~28% of network), Q2 revenue $20.9M, >60 MW across seven U.S. sites, ordered 9,000 Antminer Z15 Pro (7.56 GH/s) for Q4 2026 shipments
Zcash founder Zooko Wilcox says the Community Grants Committee holds about 40% of the ZECUSD development fund amid debate over governance and proposals to change or cut the fund.
A whale bought 10,160 ZECUSD at $630 and sold near $1,458 about a month later, netting roughly $8.29M, per on-chain analyst Yu Jin and Odaily report.
ZEC/USD: Zcash redirects part of block rewards into an inflation-funded developer fund, altering issuance and miner rewards to finance upgrades, security research and ecosystem public goods.
XXAntiWar cut ZECUSD shorts twice in three days, locking a $398,000 loss. Since September it opened eight ZEC short trades (5 wins, 3 losses), net ZEC profit $437,000.
